assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: polished landscape background illustration for the menu of a cozy puzzle game called Magnetic Garden; no lettering in the artwork.
Primary request: a refined miniature ceramic greenhouse garden with a small pair of whimsical horseshoe magnets, one muted coral and one lake blue, resting among charming potted flowers. The magnets should feel like crafted ceramic garden objects, with smooth rounded ends and no labels. The scene should establish a warm, tranquil, playful world.
Scene/backdrop: sunlit little greenhouse, pale mint painted window frames, softly frosted glass, cream ceramic potting bench. Flowering plants in simple rounded ceramic pots, small leaves and gently curling stems, pink cosmos-like blooms, tiny yellow flowers. A little soil and a few rounded pebbles.
Style/medium: exquisite tactile handpainted storybook illustration, subtle gouache surface, soft dimensional ceramic forms, delicate botanical detail, restrained editorial game art, not photorealistic and not a generic plastic 3D render.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 image, delightful cohesive scene with pots and magnets clustered across the lower two thirds, greenhouse architecture framing the scene, light breathing room at upper center; close miniature tabletop viewpoint, no user interface elements.
Lighting/mood: warm diffused morning light, soft short shadows, calm welcoming cozy atmosphere.
Color palette: warm ivory, sage and pale mint, muted coral pink, deep lake blue accents, ochre flower centers; sophisticated pastel harmony.
Constraints: opaque background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no puzzle grid, no gameplay tiles, no buttons, no borders. Avoid neon, saturated primary colors, harsh outlines, overly busy background, toy-product packaging, dark fantasy.
